context: Final first-round night of BOTH King & Queen of the Ring 2026 (SF Raw 6/15 → finals Night of Champions 6/27 Riyadh). Two engines: (1) Gunther's 'stipulation' for the 6/19 Kansas City Cody rematch = he picks the REFEREE himself, names SAMI ZAYN ('the last real good guy') — the Imperator installs his own compromised judge (Scroll 007 correct-and-denied answered by seizing the witness); (2) Solo Sikoa REFUSES Roman's 'come home' (delivered by Fatu) — Bloodline-vs-MFT war goes hot, Fatu now Roman's envoy. AAA World Cruiserweight defended on the flagship (Fénix retains vs Axiom = 'the flagship hosts but does not capture'). Outlet-reconciled post-show crawl (Joe's live reads flagged-untrusted; outlets the authority). KOTR main-event winner CONFIRMED 6/13 = Jey Uso (splash stole the pin on LA Knight off Solo's Spike + Keys' spinebuster — interference was aimed at Keys, Jey capitalized).

segments.outcome: Cody Rhodes asked Nick Aldis for Gunther's stipulation (none yet). Then the Usos: Jey talked up winning KOTR to challenge Cody at SummerSlam. Cody: 'I hope that it's Jey's decision, not Roman Reigns'.'
segments.register: the autonomy-doubt seeded into the champ's mouth
segments.notes: Cody names the exact Bloodline fault-line — is Jey his own man or Roman's instrument? Plants the question the main event will test.

segments.outcome: Queen of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Charlotte Flair def. Lyra Valkyria, Sol Ruca & Jade Cargill (w/ B-Fab & Michin) — tapped Lyra with the Figure-Eight (~18:35). Non-title. ADVANCES → SF vs Liv Morgan. Post-match: Tiffany Stratton + Alexa Bliss brawled with B-Fab & Michin through the crowd; Chelsea Green appeared with a kendo stick (confusing Stratton).
segments.register: Hera advances toward the absent queen's crown
segments.notes: Charlotte moves toward the title she vowed to take from an injured/absent Rhea. The women's-tag brawl seeds the Green/Tiffany pairing.

segments.outcome: Blake Monroe vignette re: Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss — 'Friends aren't something I ever burdened myself with.'
segments.notes: Building Monroe toward the women's division (Flair/Bliss orbit).

segments.outcome: Cathy Kelley interviewed Finn Bálor (new 'chapter' on SmackDown). R-Truth floated reuniting Judgment Day; Damian Priest noted he & Truth defend the WWE Tag Team Titles vs The MFTs next week (6/19), saying the tag titles are what matter.
segments.register: champions point at the next war
segments.notes: Sets the SD Tag defense vs the MFTs for 6/19; Bálor settling onto the brand; Truth's JD-reunion idea simmering.

segments.outcome: Non-title: Brie Bella & Paige (Women's Tag Champions) def. Fatal Influence (Fallon Henley & Lainey Reid, w/ Jacy Jayne) — after the ref ejected Jacy Jayne, Paige rolled up Lainey Reid (Henley distracted), Brie reversed Reid's counter, and Paige pinned Reid (~8:30). Pin victim CONFIRMED 6/13 = Reid (WrestleView; B/R's 'Henley' discarded).
segments.register: champs answer the attack; chase stays open
segments.notes: Champs go over non-title — the title chase continues; the heel unit loses its edge once the manager is removed.

segments.outcome: In-ring: Sami Zayn confronted Cody ('just be Cody, my friend'; 'you said you'd beat Gunther and teach me a lesson — when do you want to teach me that lesson?'). Cody: Sami 'has sucked lately,' whiny, 'I'm sorry I'm a champion and that you'll never be one.' Sami SLAPPED Cody → Cody SLAPPED him back → Sami grabbed a chair, set it down, left.
segments.notes: The 6/5 rejected-hand seed escalates to slaps. Sami's descent advancing — righteousness curdling into grievance. Sets up the ref-reveal payoff later.

segments.outcome: AAA World Cruiserweight Championship: Rey Fénix (c) def. Axiom via Mexican Musclebuster (~11:30) — RETAINED. First AAA-Cruiserweight defense on WWE TV; presented straight (no on-air storyline gloss). Finish name CONFIRMED 6/13 = Mexican Musclebuster ('Fénix Driver' was a one-outlet mislabel); NO Nathan Frazer at ringside (WrestlingInc's claim uncorroborated, discarded).
segments.register: the flagship hosts but does not capture
segments.notes: WWE platforms an AAA belt on its marquee (flagship-platforms-AAA, live) but does NOT annex the gold to a homegrown body — visiting-crown prestige protected (territory-as-visitor). The Phoenix keeps his fire. Joe's live Axiom pick = MISS; the counter-read held.

segments.outcome: Women's tag: Michin & B-Fab ('Scream Mode') def. Tiffany Stratton & Chelsea Green — Michin pinned Green (Styles Clash per one source).
segments.register: imposed alliance fails on first contact
segments.notes: Green's forced 'help' costs Tiffany immediately. Inverts the conditional-patronage pattern (patronage imposed, not granted).

segments.outcome: US-title angle: Trick Williams (w/ Lil Yachty), 'leader of the new school,' cut a promo (his KOTR loss 'woke something'). Ricky Saints interrupted → Carmelo Hayes shoved him aside. Per WWE.com, Trick def. Hayes after a Saints distraction; Trick then attacked Hayes and hit Book End on Saints, standing last → sets Saints vs Hayes for the next US-title shot. (Hayes: 'you got two guys killing themselves for a shot at your title, and you don't want to defend it'; Trick: 'I'm gonna stomp you both out anyway.')
segments.register: NXT-on-WWE; the arriviste holds his rung
segments.notes: Three NXT-forged grads (Trick/Saints/Melo) run the US-title midcard; Trick stands last over the cohort clawing beneath him. The pipeline-as-text seed (vertical singular-system).

segments.outcome: Jacob Fatu delivered Roman's message — Solo, 'come home.' Solo REFUSED: called it a 'doghouse,' Fatu 'Reigns' lapdog,' said Reigns humiliated him; 'tell Roman that if he wants me to come back home, he can come and get me.' Fatu: 'I've made my decision and I'll stand on it' — warned if Reigns sends him, 'I'll come for you.'
segments.register: the son sent against the brother; the splinter refuses absorption
segments.notes: MFT war goes hot. Fatu now Roman's ENVOY — vertical loyalty (to the father) weaponized against the horizontal family (Solo). Solo won't be reabsorbed by consent, only by force. Augury-relevant: Fatu's father-bond is the load-bearing relationship.

segments.outcome: Cathy Kelley interviewed Royce Keys before the main event; Solo Sikoa warned him the Bloodline was in the building to ensure Jey advances, said he doubts Fatu's true loyalty, and cautioned: 'I don't want you to be a casualty in Reigns' war.'
segments.notes: Royce = the liminal-warrior being recruited/protected by Solo now that Fatu went to Roman and Priest drifted.

segments.outcome: King of the Ring R1 Fatal 4-Way: Jey Uso def. LA Knight, Finn Bálor & Royce Keys (CONFIRMED 6/13 — WWE.com/WrestleView/Fightful). Finish: with Bálor down, Solo Sikoa hit LA Knight with a Samoan Spike (ref unsighted) → Royce Keys hit the Ultimate Spinebuster on Knight → Jey Uso leaped off the top with a splash and stole the pin on Knight. Winner → KOTR SF vs Je'Von Evans (6/15).
segments.notes: The interference was aimed at KEYS, not Jey — Solo's Spike + Keys' spinebuster were setting Keys up to win, and Jey stole the pin off it. So Jey advanced as himself (no one helped HIM) but by theft off the family's mess: free of the Bloodline's hand yet tainted by proximity. Cody's open-promo doubt ('Jey's decision, not Roman Reigns'?') stays live into the SF.

segments.outcome: Closing: Gunther told Aldis he can't trust WWE's officiating (the Clash blown call) so his 'stipulation' is that HE picks the special guest referee — and named SAMI ZAYN for the 6/19 Kansas City Undisputed Title rematch. Reasoning: 'someone with their heart in the right place, a good guy, maybe the last real good guy' (hijacking Zayn's own 'Last Real Good Guy' T-shirt).
segments.register: the Imperator installs his own judge
segments.notes: Gunther's answer to correct-judgment-denied (Scroll 007) = seize the WITNESS, not change the match-type — and pick one compromised by design (Cody's wronged friend). The harvest needs an honest scale; he hands it to the one man with a reason to weigh it against Cody. Verbatim-grade.
